confirmed_incompatibilities.finding: Incompatible with an AMD64 target lacking AVX/AVX2. images.conclusion: AVX2 SHA assembly is present, but correctly guarded. SHA initialization enables useAVX2 only when AVX, AVX2 and BMI2 flags are present; the block wrapper otherwise calls blockAMD64. The inspected baseline SHA/scrypt implementations contain no AVX/BMI instructions. The ScryptDigest caller invokes x/crypto/scrypt.Key.
limitations: This is static inspection of exact image binaries. Full node/pool/share runtime validation remains required.

images.conclusion: The exact libmultihash.so native hash library contains no AVX/BMI instructions. Its only DT_NEEDED dependency is libc.so.6, and SHA/scrypt entry points use portable internal implementations. No unconditional AVX2 native hashing fault was found in this library.
limitations: This is static inspection of exact image binaries. Full node/pool/share runtime validation remains required.
